title: Dark theme
author: dtech77pl
body_snippet:
Hi,

Do you think that the dark theme will be available in the next release?

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hi @dtech77pl, thanks for your interest! 🎨

Good news — mRemoteNG already ships with a **Darcula** dark theme! You can enable it via:
**Tools → Options → Theme → Darcula**

If you're looking for something specific (e.g., full dark mode including menus/toolbars), could you share a screenshot or describe what you'd like to see differently? We're happy to improve the theming system based on user feedback.

Let us know if the built-in Darcula theme works for you!

comments.author: nobodyspecial
comments.snippet:
> [@dtech77pl](https://github.com/dtech77pl) You were right — **Darcula was missing** from the theme dropdown!
> 
> **Root cause:** The theme engine loads `.vstheme` files and creates internal "NG" variants (`darculaNG`, `vs2015darkNG`, etc.) as base templates. Then it creates user-friendly embedded themes (`vs2015Light`, `vs2015Dark`, `vs2015Blue`) — but it was **not doing this for Darcula**. So the only dark theme with "darcula" in the name was the internal `darculaNG`, which was confusing and...
